command: import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';import {gunzipSync} from 'node:zlib';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';import {PlaySim} from './src/sim/playsim.ts';const read=p=>JSON.parse(gunzipSync(readFileSync(p)));const m=read('out/honest-coverage/inputs.json.gz');const observed=read('out/honest-coverage/candidate.json.gz').rows.find(r=>r.id==='QW');const sim=new PlaySim(structuredClone(m.cases.find(c=>c.id==='QW').setup));sim.event('snap',sim.slot('C')??sim.qb);let ticks=0;while(sim.phase==='live'&&sim.t<m.seconds){sim.tick();ticks++}const {frames,telemetry,...result}=sim.buildResult();const signature=createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({t:sim.t,phase:sim.phase,result,bodies:sim.agents.map(a=>a.body),rng:sim.rng,minds:sim.agents.map(a=>a.mind),perception:sim.perception})).digest('hex');if(signature!==observed.physicalSignature)throw Error('Observer changed execution');const proof={id:'QW',inputSha256:observed.inputSha256,signature,ticks,matched:true};writeFileSync('out/honest-coverage/observer-proof.json',JSON.stringify(proof));console.log(proof);
